question: From whom is all-around protection sought in this invocation to Gaṅgā?
premises: Protection is requested for the speaker
Protection is sought from all sides
Gaṅgā, who goes by three paths, is invoked
inference: Gaṅgā, the three-path-going goddess, is asked to protect the speaker from all sides.
plain_english: Protect me; may Gaṅgā, who flows along the three paths, protect me from all sides.
